vectors.name: eof-top-level
vectors.description: A backtick fence at the top level runs to the end of the input.

vectors.name: eof-tilde
vectors.description: A tilde fence runs to the end of the input.

vectors.name: eof-raw
vectors.description: A raw fence is a fence too.

vectors.name: eof-shorter-closer
vectors.description: A closer shorter than the opener does not close it.

vectors.name: under-a-paragraph
vectors.description: An opener under an open paragraph interrupts it whether or not a closer follows.

vectors.name: under-an-item-paragraph
vectors.description: Under an item's paragraph the fence runs to the end of the item.

vectors.name: under-a-quote-paragraph
vectors.description: Under a quoted paragraph the unmarked line ends the fence and the quote.

vectors.name: eof-in-item
vectors.description: The input ends while the item and the fence are open.

vectors.name: container-list-item
vectors.description: The next item ends the item, and the fence with it.

vectors.name: container-block-quote
vectors.description: A blank line ends the quote, and the fence with it.

vectors.name: div-closer-is-payload
vectors.description: A colon closer inside an unclosed fence is payload, so the fence runs on past it.

vectors.name: continuation-marker
vectors.description: A plus at the item's marker column ends the fence before the attached block (carve#3401).

vectors.name: two-fences
vectors.description: Each unclosed fence is reported, in source order.

vectors.name: closed
vectors.description: A closed fence.

vectors.name: closed-by-longer-run
vectors.description: A longer closer closes the fence.

vectors.name: closed-raw
vectors.description: A closed raw fence.

vectors.name: closed-in-item
vectors.description: A fence closed inside its item.

vectors.name: invalid-opener-is-text
vectors.description: A line whose info string is invalid is not an opener and opens nothing.

vectors.name: indented-opener-under-a-paragraph
vectors.description: An indented opener interrupts the paragraph and opens a code block.

vectors.name: colon-fence
